menu.title: OpenPak
common.need_sign_in: Sign in to OpenPak to use this.
common.copy_failed: The clipboard is not available here. Your friend code is {0}.
setup.title: Set up this profile
setup.body: Sign in to OpenPak to play online: friends, invitations and cloud saves follow this profile. Or keep it offline. You can sign in later from the OpenPak menu.
setup.verify: Finish creating your account in the browser and verify your email, then sign in here.
connect.title: Connect to OpenPak?
connect.body.wiiu: Sign in to OpenPak to play Wii U games online without a console dump: friends and cloud saves come with it. You can sign in later from the OpenPak menu.
connect.body.3ds: Sign in to OpenPak for your friend list and cloud saves. You can sign in later from the OpenPak menu.
connect.body.wfc: Sign in to OpenPak to play Nintendo Wi-Fi Connection games online and keep your saves in the cloud. Games keep their own friend codes. You can sign in later from the OpenPak menu.
signin.title: Sign in to OpenPak
signin.device_hint: How this machine appears in your account's device list.
signin.no_keychain: There is no password store on this machine, so there is nowhere safe to keep the account token. Install and unlock one, then sign in again.
signout.title: Sign out of OpenPak?
signout.body: {0} goes offline on this emulator. Your friends, invitations and cloud saves stay on your account, and you can sign in again at any time.
signout.body_single: This emulator goes offline. Your friends and cloud saves stay on your account, and you can sign in again at any time.
error.rate_limited: Too many attempts. Wait a minute and try again.
error.profile_taken: This OpenPak account is already linked to the profile "{0}". Sign in there, or sign that profile out first.
error.keychain_save: Signed in, but the token could not be saved to the password store, so it was discarded.
error.no_web: This build has no web services support.
picker.title: Who is playing?
account.no_identity: Wii and DS games have no console account; OpenPak names you and keeps your saves.
account.link_failed: Signed in, but this emulator's console account did not link.
friends.block_confirm: They will not appear on your list, cannot send you anything, and cannot see you.
friends.empty: No friends yet. Add someone by their friend code.
friends.wfc_note: These are your OpenPak friends. Wii and DS games keep their own friend codes.
invites.queued: Ready: start or resume the game and it will pick this up.
invites.in_game_note: Accept these inside the game that sent them.
invite.title: Invite friends
invite.no_friends: You have no friends to invite yet.
invite.controller_hint: A: choose   B: cancel   Down past the list: Send invite
invite.handover_failed: The game closed before the invitation could be handed over.
saves.local_synced: On this machine: last written {0}, in step with version {1}.
saves.local_never: On this machine: last written {0}, never synced with the cloud.
saves.download_confirm: Replace the local save for {0} with the cloud copy? The local one is backed up beside it.
saves.delete_confirm: Delete the cloud save for {0}? Every stored version goes, and OpenPak keeps no copy. The save on this machine is not touched.
saves.full: The OpenPak allowance is full. Connect your own storage at {0}/account/saves.
conflict.title: Choose a save
conflict.body: {0} has a save on this machine and a different one in the cloud. Choose which one to keep. The other is kept as a backup.
mods.empty: No mods published for this title.
mods.refused: {0} did not match its published hash and was refused.
na.invites.3ds: The 3DS emulator cannot join online games yet, so there are no invitations here. Your phone shows the ones you receive.
na.invites.wfc: Wii and DS games invite through their own friend codes, inside the game.
na.mods.ds: OpenPak has no mods catalogue for DS games.
na.news.miiverse: Wii U news lives in Miiverse, on the network.
na.news.3ds: 3DS news arrives through Miiverse and SpotPass, on the network.
na.news.none: Wii and DS games have no news channel.
status.no_health: The status box at {0} did not answer.
toast.signed_in_linked: Signed in as {0}, and this console is now linked to your account.
toast.sign_in_again: The OpenPak sign-in for {0} has expired. Sign in again from the OpenPak menu.
toast.saves_pulled: Cloud save for {0} downloaded; the previous local copy was kept beside it.
toast.saves_push_failed: The save for {0} did not upload: {1}
toast.saves_conflict: {0} has a save here and a different one in the cloud. Choose one on the Cloud saves page.
settings.enable_tip: When this is off the emulator behaves exactly as upstream does: offline, and nothing is sent anywhere.
settings.startup_tip: Which profile opens when the emulator starts, if there is more than one. A game started from a shortcut or launcher always uses the last one.
settings.cloud_sync: Sync cloud saves automatically when a game starts and stops
settings.redirect_dns: Point the emulated console's DNS at OpenPak
settings.website_tip: Where the account lives and where you sign in. Leave this at openpak.org unless you run your own deployment.
common.error_generic: Something went wrong. Try again in a moment.
mods.occupied: Another mod is installed for this title. Remove it first.
status.nat_no_answer: Neither NAT check server answered on UDP 10025.
crash.title: Send a crash report?
crash.body: The emulator crashed last time. Send the report to OpenPak to help fix it? Reports saved: {0}
crash.details:
A report holds the emulator version, your OS, the game that was running and the last lines of the log. If you are signed in, it is sent with your account.
